subject: Project Saffron kickoff — LLMs as pattern machines
body:
Hi Jelena,

Kicking off Project Saffron — our internal codename for the LLMs-as-general-pattern-machines effort; please use Saffron on trackers and docs. The research result: pretrained LLMs autoregressively complete complex token sequences with no additional training — procedurally generated PCFG sequences, spatial patterns from the ARC benchmark prompted as ASCII art, even sequences expressed in tokens randomly sampled from the vocabulary. In-context learning is doing all the work.

Product hypothesis: a sequence-extrapolation service for the robotics prototyping group — extrapolating state sequences into simple motions, and least-to-most prompting of reward-conditioned trajectories.

Milestones: replicate the released colab results internally by Mar 20, robotics-format eval by Apr 24, Q3 pitch by May 20. Staffing over to you.

Priya
